chunks: He said, and he said: 'Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) did not eat whilst he was leaning, at all.'
ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) eat while lying down or leaning?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in *Al-Kafi*, establishes the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) by affirming that he never ate while reclining (*muttaki*), thereby distinguishing his practice from the pre-Islamic Arab custom of lying on one's side. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a primary evidence for the recommended etiquette (*adab*) of dining, emphasizing modesty and dignity in consumption. The narration underscores the Prophet's consistent adherence to this posture, making it a normative model for the faithful to emulate in daily life.
